01 — What we treat

Care built around how you move.

Three connected programs, one continuous plan — from first assessment to full performance.

A

Physiotherapy

Hands-on, manual treatment for neck, shoulder, back, hip, knee, and joint pain of every kind. We work with our hands first — electrotherapy machines only come out when they're truly needed, not as a default.

Manual therapyAll-body pain reliefPost-op
B

Sports Rehab

Return-to-play programming for athletes at every level. We rebuild agility, endurance, speed, and multi-directional movement — getting you ground ready and confident again, not just pain-free.

AgilitySpeed & enduranceReturn to play
C

Wellness

Preventive care for everyday life — movement screening, posture correction, ergonomics, lifestyle and nutrition guidance, plus ongoing health and wellness coaching that keeps small issues from becoming big ones.

Movement screeningPosture & ergonomicsNutrition & coaching
02 — About the clinic

Recovery is a daily practice, not a one-time fix.

Daily Dose was built on one idea: consistent, well-guided movement heals better than rest alone. Every plan we write blends clinical assessment with real-world training, so you leave each session with a clear next step — not just relief.

We treat you as a person first, not a patient file. Our team builds real relationships with the people who walk through our door — you'll notice it the moment you step in. No sterile hospital feel, just a space that feels welcoming from the first visit to the last.

FocusHands-on, personal
Approach1-on-1 plans
SettingClinic & Online

Every session is a full range of motion — assessed, treated, and earned back.

— The Daily Dose Approach
A note from our founder

At Daily Dose, we believe physiotherapy is more than simply treating pain.

It is about understanding why the pain happened, how the body moves, what is limiting you, and what we can do to help you move better and live better. I started Daily Dose at 24, with a simple vision — to create a space where physiotherapy is personalised, evidence-informed, movement-focused, and genuinely patient-centred.

Whether you are an athlete trying to return to your sport, someone dealing with persistent pain, recovering after surgery, or simply looking to improve your strength and movement, our goal is the same: to help you become confident in your body again.

We don't believe in one-size-fits-all protocols. Every person has a different story, lifestyle, body, and goal. That's why we focus on detailed assessment, hands-on care where appropriate, progressive exercise, strength and conditioning, and most importantly, educating you about your body.

At Daily Dose, we don't just want to make you feel better for a day. We want to help you understand your body, build its capacity, and stay better.

Thank you for trusting us with your health and your journey.

Dr. Anik Verma
Founder, Daily Dose Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation
Move Better. Get Stronger. Live Better.
